title: Fees and Payments
facts: Tuition: set by University Council; changes annually→contact registrar/finance for current amounts
Late registration fee: applies even with dean approval; amount set by University Council
Study suspension fee: applies on formal interruption request
Withdrawal from university: must settle all tuition/fees per University Council rules
Re-enrollment fee: applies on re-admission after dismissal
Scholarships: granted to academically distinguished students per University Council + Board of Trustees system
Disciplinary financial penalties: may apply per Law 49/1972
All fee amounts subject to change→direct inquiries to finance/registrar office
